'''Mendel Douglas''' was a famous game [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|202|Douglas III}}</ref> who once journeyed across the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] region [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Douglas III]] to acquire the hide of<ref name="Gamer" /> the rare<ref name="CSWE" /> and elusive [[jackelope]]. He<ref name="Gamer" /> succeeded in catching his quarry,<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-imagination-mythological-creatures-in-star-wars-part-2|text=Drawing from the Imagination: Mythological Creatures in ''Star Wars'', Part 2|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref> which made it back for his collection, but Douglas himself did not. The [[Douglas system/Legends|Douglas system]] and its third planet were thus named after the [[Death/Legends|late]] hunter.<ref name="Gamer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mendel Douglas was first mentioned in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] article "[[A Campaign Guide to the Centrality]]," written by [[Michael Kogge]] for [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]]. Kogge's article expanded on [[Canon|lore]] originally created by author [[L. Neil Smith]] for the<ref name="Gamer" /> [[1983]]<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] novel series,<ref name="Gamer" /> which first mentioned the planet Douglas III.<ref name="Mindharp">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>

According to [[Star Wars Insider 145|''Star Wars Insider'' 145]], Smith [[Tuckerization|cannibalized]] the names of colleagues to create names for Douglas III and [[Paulking XIV|other]] [[Arleen|subjects]] from the series.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|145|Authors of the Expanded Universe|Authors of the Expanded Universe: L. Neil Smith}}</ref> In popular culture, twentieth-century [[Wikipedia:Taxidermy|taxidermist]] Douglas Herrick is credited with creating the American [[Wikipedia:Jackalope|jackalope]]&mdash;a legendary animal with a [[Wikipedia:Hare|jackrabbit's]] body and the antlers of a [[Wikipedia:Pronghorn|pronghorn antelope]]&mdash;which developed into a tourist attraction in Herrick's hometown of [[Wikipedia:Douglas, Wyoming|Douglas, Wyoming]], where jackalope hunting licenses are sold.<ref name="NY Times">{{WebCite|url=http://www.nytimes.com/2003/01/19/us/douglas-herrick-82-dies-father-of-west-s-jackalope.html|text=Douglas Herrick, 82, Dies; Father of West's Jackalope|author=Martin, Douglas|date=2003-01-19|work=[[Wikipedia:The New York Times|The New York Times]]|archivedate=20170916034716}}</ref>
